card.name: Punctuation and digits in news-style medical text
card.fires_on: Single punctuation marks, spaces or digits inside news-style or citation passages about HIV drugs, regenerative medicine or journal references. Examples are an opening parenthesis after a journal year, a full stop ending a sentence, or a zero in a large number.

modes.label: Citation and bracket marks
modes.description: An opening parenthesis or space just after a journal name, year or virus name.

modes.label: Digits inside large figures
modes.description: A digit within a dollar amount, patient count or year in magazine-style text about the AIDS drug market.

modes.label: Sentence-end and mid-phrase breaks
modes.description: A full stop or a connecting word in magazine-style news about medicine.
